The '''Tamazall Militia''' were a [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|law enforcement]] organization on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tamazall/Legends|Tamazall]]. A large number guarded [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] [[Brahle Logris]], but were killed during a break-out organized by [[Kumac]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]].<ref name="Your Qualifications Have Been Considered">{{WEGCite|book=Galaxy Guide 11: Criminal Organizations|story=Your Qualifications Have Been Considered}}</ref>
